meta.title: Air-Art MMC — Professional HVAC & Engineering Solutions
meta.description: Air-Art MMC is an engineering company with 23 years of experience in heating, cooling, ventilation, VRF, chiller, and boiler systems — from design to installation and after-sales service.

hero.subtitle: With 23 years of experience, we design, install, and service heating, cooling, ventilation, VRF, chiller, and boiler systems across Azerbaijan.

about.title: An engineering company built on trust and technical depth
about.lead: Air-Art MMC delivers modern heating, cooling, and ventilation technologies — from project design and supply to installation, commissioning, and long-term technical service.
about.body: For more than two decades we have engineered comfort and process climate systems for offices, hospitals, hotels, shopping centers, and industrial facilities. Our work combines proven brands, disciplined engineering, and reliable after-sales support.

experience.desc: 23 years in engineering and 12 years as an official partner of Toshiba and Air Plus in Azerbaijan.
